## Appie

**Hosted MCP · Three agent skills** · License: MIT · Publisher: [appierun](https://github.com/appierun)

Bring Appie’s writing, chatbot and link tools into your agent workflow. Pick the skill for the job and follow its individual setup instructions.

- **[Build a chatbot](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/appierun/appie-mcp/appie-chatbot/)** (appie-chatbot). Supply knowledge sources, track training and chat with a bot through Appie.

<a id="coalwash"></a>

## CoalWash

**Claude Code plugin · Memory maintenance** · License: Apache-2.0 · Publisher: [TheColliery](https://github.com/TheColliery)

Measure memory and governance-file overhead, run maintenance, and inspect the changes. CoalWash pairs a structured-token guard with transaction snapshots and rollback tools.

- **Measure the overhead.** Inspect always-loaded memory and governance files before choosing a maintenance pass.
- **Review the changes.** Use snapshots and rollback tools to inspect and recover transaction changes.
- **Check structured tokens.** Detect drops in tracked tokens such as paths, numbers and commands. Review prose meaning separately.

### Setup

Requires Claude Code and Node.js. Install the complete plugin so its commands, hooks and engine are available together.

```sh
claude plugin marketplace add TheColliery/CoalWash
claude plugin install coalwash@coalwash
```

**Hook behavior.** The plugin registers SessionStart, Stop, PreToolUse and PostToolUse hooks. Default automatic mode can direct Quick maintenance without a new prompt; Full semantic work requires consent and uses your agent’s model. Stop hooks can hold session completion while maintenance is addressed.

**Guard coverage.** The edit guard snapshots supported Edit, Write and MultiEdit changes to memory and governance files and reports tracked-token drops. Shell writes are outside that edit guard. Token checks do not establish semantic preservation; inspect diffs and rollback results.

## Costory

**Hosted MCP · Four FinOps skills** · License: Apache-2.0 · Publisher: [costory-io](https://github.com/costory-io)

Investigate cost changes, explore BigQuery spend, and map shared costs to teams with an agent connected to Costory. Four workflows cover discovery, evidence, allocation and review.

- **[Investigate BigQuery costs](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/costory-io/costory-finops-mcp-skills/bigquery/)** (bigquery). Compare compute and storage billing, explore query and dataset costs, and review allocation options.
- **[Explain what changed](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/costory-io/costory-finops-mcp-skills/cost-change-investigation/)** (cost-change-investigation). Trace contributors and timing, check usage and operational evidence, and separate supported explanations from assumptions.
- **[Allocate shared costs](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/costory-io/costory-finops-mcp-skills/virtual-dimensions/)** (virtual-dimensions). Draft custom cost axes, preview leftovers and rule overlap, then publish approved allocation rules.
- **[Start with the right workflow](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/costory-io/costory-finops-mcp-skills/costory-finops/)** (costory-finops). Choose the Costory tools and detailed skills for spend queries, investigations, budgets, dashboards, reports and alerts.

### Setup

Requires a Costory workspace with billing data connected and its hosted MCP at https://app-api.costory.io/mcp, authenticated through browser OAuth. Queries use workspace cost data. Preview changes and confirm before publishing allocations, delivering reports or applying schema changes. Each linked skill page includes setup and source details.

Accepted scope: **4 skills**. Follow each linked skill’s individual setup instructions.

## Opsibyte

**Six skills · Publishing, budgets, listings, and music** · License: MIT · Publisher: [MelMayssonOwen](https://github.com/MelMayssonOwen)

Six focused workflows combine human-reviewed publishing and launch preparation with local budget, listing-copy, and chord helpers. Each listing carries its own source-derived quality report and setup details.

- **[Prepare a social schedule](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/melmayssonowen/agent-skills/timetopost-social-scheduler/)** (timetopost-social-scheduler). Draft distinct social posts, review account timing, and approve the exact content and schedule before publication.
- **[Review blog drafts](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/melmayssonowen/agent-skills/timetopost-autoseo-blog/)** (timetopost-autoseo-blog). Connect a publishing destination, explore article topics, and prepare blog drafts for human review.
- **[Prepare a product launch](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/melmayssonowen/agent-skills/toolfound-launch-kit/)** (toolfound-launch-kit). Research a product category, prepare an approved Toolfound submission, and track owner verification and launch status.
- **[Create a budget workbook](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/melmayssonowen/agent-skills/sheetfolk-budget-builder/)** (sheetfolk-budget-builder). Create a local Excel budget workbook with household, sinking-fund, and side-hustle inputs.
- **[Review listing copy](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/melmayssonowen/agent-skills/amazon-listing-checker/)** (amazon-listing-checker). Review pasted listing copy for length, repeated terms, risky wording, and keyword coverage using a local Python helper.
- **[Practice and transpose chords](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/melmayssonowen/agent-skills/clef-music-tools/)** (clef-music-tools). Transpose chord symbols locally or use Clef MCP tools for piano chords, guitar-tab notes, and music practice.

### Setup

Install one selected skill. TimeToPost needs its hosted MCP and browser OAuth; Toolfound and Clef document public discovery endpoints. Hosted services were not exercised in this review. Python 3 runs the local helpers. At the reviewed revision, use a new budget filename and calculate net cash flow separately; preserve existing campaign attribution manually. Upstream PR #1 supplies the tested corrections. Each skill page links its exact setup and source.

Accepted scope: **6 skills**. Follow each linked skill’s individual setup instructions.
